cn_steps: 启用 `CelestialVault`（运行时 `CelestialVault`，编辑器 `CelestialVaultEditor`）。
关卡里放置或选中 `DaySequence` 相关 Actor，把天穹实现切到基于星历的 `Celestial Vault`（地球），而不是普通天空大气材质。
在细节面板核对经纬度、日期时间和星历源，让太阳/月亮位置跟地理时间对齐。
Sequencer 里对 Day Sequence 打关键帧做昼夜；PIE 里看太阳方向是否随时间走。
游戏模块只依赖 `CelestialVault`；`CelestialVaultEditor` 不要写进 Game Target。
en_steps: Enable `CelestialVault` (runtime `CelestialVault`, editor `CelestialVaultEditor`).
In the level, use a `DaySequence` actor and pick the ephemeris-based `Celestial Vault` for Earth instead of a generic sky atmosphere material.
Set latitude/longitude, date/time, and the ephemeris source in Details so sun/moon match geography.
Keyframe the Day Sequence in Sequencer; in PIE confirm the sun moves with time.
Game modules depend on `CelestialVault` only; keep `CelestialVaultEditor` off Game targets.
note_cn: 这是 Day Sequence 的地球天穹实现，不是普通 Sky Atmosphere 后处理。
note_en: A Day Sequence celestial vault for Earth, not the stock Sky Atmosphere post-process.

cn_steps: 启用编辑器插件 `Changelist Reviews`（模块 `ChangelistReview`）并重启。
先在 `Revision Control` 里连上 Perforce（或当前源码管理），提交或挂起一个 changelist。
打开 `Window` / 源码管理相关面板，用 `ChangelistReview` 查看该 changelist 的文件与审阅状态，而不是去 Content Browser 搜组件。
不要把 `ChangelistReview` 写进游戏 `Build.cs` 或 Shipping 包。
en_steps: Enable the editor plugin `Changelist Reviews` (module `ChangelistReview`) and restart.
Connect Perforce (or your revision control) and create or shelve a changelist.
Open the revision-control UI and inspect that changelist with `ChangelistReview`; this is not a gameplay component.
Do not add `ChangelistReview` to a game `Build.cs` or a shipping cook.
note_cn: 仅服务编辑器源码审阅，默认不进 Shipping。
note_en: Editor-only changelist review; it does not ship.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Chaos Caching USD`（模块 `ChaosCachingUSD`）。
关卡里先用 Chaos Cache Manager 录一段刚体/破坏缓存（Chaos Caching）。
通过 USD Stage / 导出管线把该 Chaos Cache 写成 USD，供外部 DCC 或再导入对拍。
不要把它当实时 Chaos 求解器本身；求解仍由 Chaos 运行时完成，本插件只管 USD 进出。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Chaos Caching USD` (module `ChaosCachingUSD`).
Record a rigid/destruction take with a Chaos Cache Manager first.
Export that cache through the USD stage/export path for DCC or round-trip.
This is not the Chaos solver; simulation stays in Chaos runtime, this plugin only does USD I/O.
note_cn: Experimental：把已录制的 Chaos Cache 接到 USD，不是在 USD 里跑物理。
note_en: Experimental USD I/O for recorded Chaos caches, not physics inside USD.

cn_steps: 在已启用 Chaos Cloth Asset 的前提下启用 `Chaos Cloth Asset Dataflow Nodes`（`ChaosClothAssetDataflowNodes`）。
打开 Cloth Asset 的 Dataflow 图，从节点面板加入该插件提供的布料数据流节点（导入、约束、碰撞代理等）。
编译 Dataflow 后，把结果接到 Cloth Asset 再赋给骨架网格的 Clothing。
游戏运行时不要直接依赖这个节点模块；它服务于资产构建图。
en_steps: With Chaos Cloth Asset enabled, enable `Chaos Cloth Asset Dataflow Nodes` (`ChaosClothAssetDataflowNodes`).
Open the Cloth Asset Dataflow graph and add this plugin’s cloth nodes (import, constraints, collision proxies).
Compile the graph, then assign the Cloth Asset to the skeletal mesh clothing slot.
Do not depend on this node module at game runtime; it is for the asset build graph.
note_cn: 给 Cloth Asset Dataflow 用的节点包，不是旧版 Clothing 工具栏。
note_en: Dataflow nodes for Cloth Asset authoring, not the legacy Clothing toolbar.

cn_steps: 启用 `Chaos Cloth Asset Editor Core`（`ChaosClothAssetEditor`、`ChaosClothAssetEditorTools`）。
内容浏览器双击 `Cloth Asset`，用该核心编辑器改面板、视口和工具，而不是 Cascade 或旧 Clothing 窗口。
在编辑器里绑定骨架、碰撞体和模拟参数，保存后再把资产挂到角色。
`ChaosClothAssetEditor*` 只能进 Editor Target。
en_steps: Enable `Chaos Cloth Asset Editor Core` (`ChaosClothAssetEditor`, `ChaosClothAssetEditorTools`).
Double-click a `Cloth Asset` and author it in this editor, not Cascade or the legacy Clothing window.
Bind skeleton, colliders, and sim settings, save, then assign the asset on the character.
Keep `ChaosClothAssetEditor*` on Editor targets only.
note_cn: 新 Cloth Asset 编辑器的核心 UI，不含具体 USD/Dataflow 节点。
note_en: Core UI for the new Cloth Asset editor; USD/Dataflow nodes live in sibling plugins.

cn_steps: 在插件列表里找到 `Chaos Cloth Asset Editor (Deprecated)`，新项目不要启用。
已有工程若仍打开旧 Cloth Asset 编辑器，按引擎提示迁到 `Chaos Cloth Asset Editor Core`。
不要在 `Build.cs` 里新增对该过时描述符的依赖。
迁移完成后在 `Edit > Plugins` 禁用本插件，避免两套编辑器抢同一资产。
en_steps: Find `Chaos Cloth Asset Editor (Deprecated)` and do not enable it on new projects.
If an existing project still opens the old Cloth Asset editor, migrate to `Chaos Cloth Asset Editor Core`.
Do not add new `Build.cs` dependencies on this deprecated descriptor.
After migration, disable this plugin so two editors do not fight over the same asset.
note_cn: 已废弃的 Cloth Asset 编辑器壳，没有可依赖的运行时模块列表。
note_en: Deprecated editor shell; it ships no runtime module list to depend on.

cn_steps: 启用 `Chaos Cloth Asset USD Dataflow Nodes`（`ChaosClothAssetUsdDataflowNodes`）。
在 Cloth Asset Dataflow 里加入 USD 导入/导出节点，指向 `.usd` 服装或绑定缓存。
跑图生成或更新 Cloth Asset，再赋给骨架网格。
没有 USD 工作流就不必启用；普通布料编辑用 Cloth Asset 编辑器即可。
en_steps: Enable `Chaos Cloth Asset USD Dataflow Nodes` (`ChaosClothAssetUsdDataflowNodes`).
Add USD import/export nodes on the Cloth Asset Dataflow graph and point them at a `.usd` garment or bind cache.
Run the graph to build or refresh the Cloth Asset, then assign it to the skeletal mesh.
Skip this plugin if you are not on a USD cloth pipeline; use the Cloth Asset editor instead.
note_cn: 只负责 Cloth Asset 图上的 USD 节点，不是通用 USD Importer。
note_en: USD nodes for Cloth Asset Dataflow, not the general USD Importer.

cn_steps: 启用 `Chaos Cloth Asset`（`ChaosClothAsset`、`ChaosClothAssetEngine`、`ChaosClothAssetTools`）。
内容浏览器 `Add` 创建 `Cloth Asset`，在 Cloth Asset 编辑器里绑骨骼、碰撞和约束。
把资产赋到骨架网格体的 Clothing / Cloth Asset 槽，PIE 里看布料随动画动。
运行时游戏模块依赖 `ChaosClothAsset` / `ChaosClothAssetEngine`；工具模块才用 `ChaosClothAssetTools`。
en_steps: Enable `Chaos Cloth Asset` (`ChaosClothAsset`, `ChaosClothAssetEngine`, `ChaosClothAssetTools`).
Create a `Cloth Asset` and bind skeleton, collision, and constraints in its editor.
Assign it to the skeletal mesh Clothing / Cloth Asset slot and PIE to see it follow animation.
Runtime game modules use `ChaosClothAsset` / `ChaosClothAssetEngine`; `ChaosClothAssetTools` is for tools.
note_cn: 新一代 Chaos 布料资产，替代旧 Apex/Clothing 工作流。
note_en: The new Chaos cloth asset, replacing the old Apex/Clothing workflow.

cn_steps: 插件名带 Deprecated：新项目改用 `Chaos Cloth` + `Chaos Cloth Asset` 编辑器。
旧工程若还靠本插件打开历史 Cloth 资产，按迁移提示另存为 Cloth Asset。
不要把已废弃编辑器模块写进新的 `*Editor.Build.cs`。
迁移后禁用本插件。
en_steps: This plugin is Deprecated; new work uses `Chaos Cloth` plus the `Chaos Cloth Asset` editor.
If a legacy project still opens old cloth assets here, resave them as Cloth Assets.
Do not add the deprecated editor modules to a new `*Editor.Build.cs`.
Disable the plugin after migration.
note_cn: 旧 Chaos 布料编辑器，将随引擎移除。
note_en: Legacy Chaos cloth editor scheduled for removal.

cn_steps: 启用 `Chaos Cloth Generator`，用于从网格/面板生成布料资产，而不是手绘每一条约束。
在 Cloth / Dataflow 相关编辑器里跑 Generator 节点或命令，输入服装网格，输出 Cloth Asset。
检查生成的碰撞与约束，再挂到角色上模拟。
这是制作管线工具，不要当运行时布料求解器依赖。
en_steps: Enable `Chaos Cloth Generator` to build cloth assets from meshes/panels instead of authoring every constraint by hand.
Run its generator node or command in the Cloth / Dataflow editor: mesh in, Cloth Asset out.
Inspect generated collision and constraints, then simulate on the character.
Pipeline tool only; do not treat it as the runtime cloth solver.
note_cn: 生成器，不是 PIE 里驱动布料的那个 Chaos Cloth 运行时。
note_en: A generator, not the Chaos Cloth runtime that ticks in PIE.

cn_steps: 启用 `Chaos Cloth` 作为角色服装的运行时求解。
骨架网格使用 Cloth Asset（或仍支持的 Clothing 数据），确认项目物理是 Chaos。
PIE 里播放动画，看裙摆/外套；过硬或穿插时回到 Cloth Asset 调阻尼、碰撞半径、约束。
需要编辑器工具时再开 Cloth Asset Editor；本插件负责运行时模拟。
en_steps: Enable `Chaos Cloth` as the runtime solver for character garments.
Put a Cloth Asset (or supported Clothing data) on the skeletal mesh and confirm the project uses Chaos physics.
PIE an animation; if cloth is stiff or clips, tweak damping, collision radius, and constraints on the asset.
Turn on the Cloth Asset editor plugins for authoring; this plugin is the runtime sim.
note_cn: 运行时 Chaos 布料求解，需搭配 Cloth Asset 才有可调资产。
note_en: Runtime Chaos cloth; authoring lives in the Cloth Asset editor plugins.

cn_steps: 启用 Experimental 的 `Chaos Composable Solver`。
在需要组合多种 Chaos 求解（刚体/布料/可变形）的关卡或系统里，按插件文档把 composable solver 接到现有 Chaos 场景，而不是再放一个独立 Physics Scene。
先在空关卡验证求解顺序与稳定性，再进正式内容。
接口可能随夜构建变化，不要写死未文档化的内部类型。
en_steps: Enable Experimental `Chaos Composable Solver`.
Wire the composable solver into the existing Chaos scene when you must combine rigid/cloth/deformable solves; do not spawn a second physics scene.
Prove solver order and stability in an empty map before production content.
The contract can change on nightlies; do not freeze undocumented internal types.
note_cn: Experimental 组合求解器，不是默认世界里的 Chaos 场景替换开关。
note_en: Experimental composable solver, not a drop-in replacement toggle for the default Chaos world.

cn_steps: 启用 `Chaos Deformable Base`，作为 Flesh/可变形体的公共运行时底座。
游戏或插件模块若要调用可变形 API，在 `Build.cs` 依赖该底座，再依赖具体的 Chaos Flesh 等上层插件。
不要单独指望它提供可放置的 Actor；场景里放的是 Flesh 资产/组件。
编辑器工具走 Flesh Generator / Flesh 编辑器，不走这个 base 模块的 UI。
en_steps: Enable `Chaos Deformable Base` as the shared runtime for Flesh/deformables.
If your module calls deformable APIs, depend on this base, then on Chaos Flesh (or similar) above it.
It does not ship a placeable actor; you place Flesh assets/components.
Authoring UI lives in Flesh Generator / Flesh editors, not this base module.
note_cn: 可变形求解的底层库，最终用户应通过 Chaos Flesh 使用。
note_en: Low-level deformable runtime; end users go through Chaos Flesh.

cn_steps: 启用 `Chaos Flesh Generator`，用来从封闭三角网格生成四面体 Flesh 资产。
在 Flesh / Dataflow 工具里选网格，跑四面体化与绑定，输出 Flesh Asset。
把生成结果交给 `Chaos Flesh` 运行时，挂到角色或缓存网格上模拟。
生成失败时先检查网格是否封闭、法线是否统一，而不是去改 Chaos 场景重力。
en_steps: Enable `Chaos Flesh Generator` to tet-mesh a closed triangle mesh into a Flesh asset.
In the Flesh / Dataflow tools, pick the mesh, tetrahedralize and bind, and save a Flesh Asset.
Simulate it with the `Chaos Flesh` runtime on a character or cached mesh.
If generation fails, fix watertightness and normals before touching world gravity.
note_cn: 四面体生成器，不是 PIE 里的软体求解循环。
note_en: Tetrahedralizer, not the soft-body tick in PIE.

cn_steps: 启用 `Chaos Flesh` 做四面体软体（肌肉、脂肪、可变形体）。
准备 Flesh Asset（可用 Flesh Generator），把它赋给支持的网格/组件。
PIE 中看体积保持与碰撞；过软过硬时调 Flesh 资产上的材料与约束，而不是 Niagara。
需要缓存或影视拍屏时再接 Chaos Cache；本插件是运行时软体求解。
en_steps: Enable `Chaos Flesh` for tetrahedral soft bodies (muscle, fat, deformables).
Author a Flesh Asset (Flesh Generator helps) and assign it to a supported mesh/component.
PIE to judge volume and collision; tune material and constraints on the Flesh asset, not Niagara.
Use Chaos Cache for takes; this plugin is the runtime soft-body solve.
note_cn: Chaos 软体运行时，依赖 Deformable Base；与布料（Cloth）是另一套管线。
note_en: Chaos soft-body runtime on Deformable Base; cloth is a separate pipeline.
